title: crocus biflorus subsp. weldenii
intro: Crocus biflorus subsp. weldenii, commonly known as Weld's crocus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the iris family, characterized by its vibrant purple flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its antipyretic and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Crocus biflorus subsp. weldenii are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
